title: My Family
text:
My family lives in a small house. There are four people in my family: my mother, my father, my sister and me. We eat dinner together every evening.

My sister is ten years old. She likes to draw pictures. My father cooks on Sundays, and he makes the best soup.

questions.text: How many people are in the family?
What can we infer about the family?
options: They do not like each other
They live in a big city

questions.text: Which person is probably a good cook?

vocabulary.definition: a group of people who are related to each other

paragraph_translations: Moja rodzina mieszka w małym domu. W mojej rodzinie są cztery osoby: mama, tata, siostra i ja. Co wieczór jemy razem kolację.
Moja siostra ma dziesięć lat. Lubi rysować obrazki. Mój tata gotuje w niedziele i robi najlepszą zupę.
